extracted.name: Easy Avocado Spread
extracted.description: This recipe combines avocados with dry ranch dressing and a splash of lemon juice to make a delicious spread. Great on sandwiches or as a veggie dip!
ingredient_lines: 2 ripe avocados - peeled, pitted, and mashed
instruction_lines: Stir avocados, ranch dressing mix, lemon juice, and light mayonnaise together in a bowl. Chill for 1 hour.
